purpose: untouched gate slice for the generic-surface stoplist candidate (schema GENERIC_SLUGS extension); surface-first gold with contract-derived IDs; not independent human gold

selection.population: processed papers excluding all 72 papers in dev12, cross-check12, holdout v3, v4, v5, and v6
selection.eligibility: abstract length >= 300 and neutral extraction cue regex present: dataset|benchmark|corpus|evaluate|experiment|method|model|framework|task|propose|introduce (with inflections)
selection.prediction_blind_detail: selected and labelled from processed abstracts only; per-paper extractor caches and data/enriched predictions for these IDs were not read before the freeze

annotation.protocol_text: Same inclusion protocol as v6: one entity per concept; surface = first fullest verbatim name span (including parenthesized acronym when written); include named methods/models/frameworks proposed, used, or compared, named datasets/benchmarks, conventional named tasks; exclude generic model families, generic nouns, metrics, products, diseases, and paper-internal descriptive components; relations follow mention-implies-link plus METHOD_EVALUATED_ON only when explicitly stated.
annotation.gold_id_derivation: src/enrichment/merge.py::_canonicalize_llm(surface, type, gazetteer v1.2, context=sentence containing the surface); independent of GENERIC_SLUGS, so the stoplist candidate cannot influence gold IDs.

candidate_change: schema.py GENERIC_SLUGS extended with domain-general bare capability nouns, metric names, and research-activity terms observed as slug-resolved false positives on v4/v6; gazetteer and extractor unchanged

decision_rule.role: one-shot gate for the generic-surface stoplist candidate
decision_rule.go_threshold: candidate both F1 >= 0.50 on the first v7 score AND candidate >= retained on both metrics on the same v7 slice (paired, both scored from the retained cache without tuning)

limitations: Single nonhuman annotator; no inter-annotator agreement.
Selection is cue-enriched rather than a prevalence estimate for all 1,091 papers.
Small slice; wide bootstrap intervals; cannot satisfy an independent-human gate.
Gold IDs inherit the frozen canonicalizer contract; canonicalizer quirks surface as system errors under that contract.
